description: Canonical frontend performance budgets for V2-FE-130. Route JS budgets are raw uncompressed first-load byte counts (1 KiB = 1024 bytes) enforced at build time against .next/diagnostics/route-bundle-stats.json generated by next build. Web-vitals budgets are enforced at runtime by the PerformanceBudgetIndicator using browser PerformanceObserver data. Baselines were captured from a production build on commit 5333c0a; budgets are baseline + headroom and must be tightened, never loosened, without review.
